task.title: Page persisted recurrence occurrences through the CLI
task.objective: Complete issue https://github.com/Knosence9/project-vela/issues/887 by exposing bounded sparse persisted-occurrence provenance through one deterministic read-only CLI command.
acceptance_criteria: Validate recurrence identity and bounded page size before opening storage, then delegate paging to the authoritative recurrence store.
Emit ordered compact JSON with complete occurrence provenance and the authored-offset continuation cursor.
Fail closed for missing definitions, invalid starts, selected corruption, storage, and serialization errors without creating or mutating storage.

attempts.diagnostic: The deterministic persisted-occurrence paging test failed because persisted was not a recognized recurrence subcommand.
attempts.patch: Added tests for sparse and final pages, cursor progress, full provenance, validation ordering, missing evidence, selected corruption, unrelated-corruption isolation, and read-only behavior.

attempts.summary: Implemented the direct read-only paging adapter.
attempts.diagnostic: Reimplementing sparse selection or cursor semantics in the CLI would duplicate the kernel contract and widen the corruption domain.
attempts.patch: Added recurrence persisted over RecurrenceStore::persisted_occurrences_page, reused page JSON serialization, mapped deterministic diagnostics, and documented the narrow authority boundary in ADR-0049 and scheduler guidance.

attempts.summary: Preserved merge safety through review throttling.
attempts.diagnostic: CodeRabbit initially returned a false-green rate-limited status with a 32-minute cooldown; its later exact-head review suggested a low-value validation helper that would couple parsing to ExitCode.
attempts.patch: Kept auto-merge disabled through the cooldown, deliberately resumed review once, retained the two short command-local validation mappings, and merged only after the exact-head Rust gate, substantive review, and zero unresolved threads.

outcome.summary: Operators can page sparse persisted recurrence provenance through deterministic read-only CLI JSON while kernel paging, validation, cursor, and corruption semantics remain authoritative.

verification.command: nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- record validate corpus/development/0175-persisted-recurrence-paging-cli.json # result: valid development record
nix develop --command cargo run --locked -p vela-dev -- corpus inspect corpus/development # result: inspected 177 records: 177 valid, 0 invalid

lessons: CLI paging should delegate sparse selection and authored-offset cursor semantics to the kernel rather than infer them from returned rows.
Input validation before storage access preserves deterministic diagnostics and guarantees invalid requests do not create a database.
A green automated-review status is not merge evidence when the review body reports throttling; preserve the exact head until a genuine review completes.
Small command-local validation adapters can remain explicit when extracting them would couple domain parsing to process exit behavior.
Read-only persisted provenance does not grant global discovery, due policy, materialization, dispatch, retry, or execution authority.
